film: The Boer: A Dutch Farmer Rebellion
title: The Boer: A Dutch Farmer Rebellion Film Poster
blurb: Rebel News reporters Lewis Brackpool and Lincoln Jay embedded with Dutch farmers in 2022 as they rose up against a government plan to cut nitrogen emissions by shrinking their herds and their farms.

film: Church Under Fire: Canada's War on Christianity
title: Church Under Fire: Canada's War on Christianity Film Poster
blurb: Sheila Gunn Reid's documentary on the pressures facing Christian communities in Canada, from pandemic-era church closures to the wider clash between governments and people of faith, told through interviews with the pastors who lived it.

title: Culling the Cure Film Poster
blurb: Drea Humphrey's documentary follows a rural British Columbia farm family's fight to save more than 300 ostriches from a cull ordered by the Canadian Food Inspection Agency.

title: Destiny Uncut Film Poster
blurb: Avi Yemini goes inside New Zealand's Destiny Church to tell the story of its leader, Brian Tamaki, and the culture war around him.

title: Dope Train: Edmonton's Media Blackout Film Poster
blurb: Narrated by Sheila Gunn Reid, this documentary looks at crime and disorder on Edmonton's light rail system, and at the city directive that kept journalists from reporting inside it.

title: The Great Reset: Episode 1 Film Poster
blurb: The first episode of Rebel News's Expose the Reset series, which follows the World Economic Forum, its annual meeting in Davos and the people who gather there.

title: The Great Reset: Episode 2 Film Poster
blurb: The second episode of the Expose the Reset series, produced by Kian Simone with Lewis Brackpool, returns to Davos to look at the World Economic Forum and the role technology plays in its plans.

title: Greta Inc. Film Poster
blurb: Keean Bexte's investigation into Greta Thunberg and the people and organizations behind her rise, including his own attempt to put questions to her directly.

title: Kamloops: The Buried Truth Film Poster
blurb: Matt Brevner's documentary examines the May 2021 announcement about the former Kamloops Indian Residential School in British Columbia, and what has and has not happened at the site since.

film: MAID: The Dark Side of Canadian Compassion
title: MAID: The Dark Side of Canadian Compassion Film Poster
blurb: A Rebel News documentary on Canada's medical assistance in dying regime and its expansion, told through interviews with veterans, advocates and families affected by it.

title: Plaasmoorde: The Killing Fields Film Poster
blurb: Katie Hopkins travels to South Africa to report on farm attacks, speaking with victims' families, farmers and police.

title: RAID Film Poster
blurb: The story of a standoff between Rebel News journalists and Montreal police, told with the footage the team recorded as it happened.

film: Trucker Rebellion: The Story of the Coutts Blockade
title: Trucker Rebellion: The Story of the Coutts Blockade Film Poster
blurb: A firsthand account of the truckers' protest against vaccine mandates at the border crossing in Coutts, Alberta, in early 2022.

title: Trucker Rebellion: Convoy to Ottawa Film Poster
blurb: Rebel News reporters travelled with the Freedom Convoy from Calgary to Ottawa, recording the journey and interviewing the truckers and organizers, Tamara Lich among them.

title: Trucker Rebellion: Trudeau on Trial Film Poster
blurb: Kian Simone's documentary on the Public Order Emergency Commission, the inquiry into the federal government's use of the Emergencies Act against the Ottawa convoy protest in February 2022.

film: Uncancelable: The Future of Comedy with the Danger Cats
title: Uncancelable: The Future of Comedy with the Danger Cats Film Poster
blurb: A short documentary on the Danger Cats, the Canadian comedy troupe whose shows were cancelled after a backlash, and their decision to answer it with more comedy.

title: Ungovernable: Alberta's Quest for Independence Film Poster
blurb: A Rebel News documentary on Alberta's history with Ottawa and the movement to take back the province's sovereignty.

title: Unsilenced: Canada's Underground Medical Rebellion Film Poster
blurb: Tamara Ugolini reports from the Free Speech in Medicine conference in Baddeck, Nova Scotia, where doctors and citizens met to discuss the health questions they say they were told not to ask.
